verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable in the open-webui/open-webui GitHub repository, and community members describe it as a prominent OSS project. However, the current license is BSD-3 with custom branding clauses added. Commenters report this moves away from permissive licensing, makes forking practically impossible, and follows two license changes in one year (MIT → BSD-3 → custom). That makes the 'open license' part of the story significantly qualified. Missing for 10: a standard OSI-approved license without added branding restrictions, first-party documentation of the license terms, and a stable licensing history.
